codeReview.summary: The implementation satisfies the revisit-continuity contract. Public booking detail now reconstructs the canonical `/bookings/recover` entrypoint for signed-out revisits after token stripping when a valid recovery cookie still exists, and falls back to the same recovery-first sign-in intent when reconstruction fails. Targeted tests cover the new redirect path and the surrounding recovery flow remains aligned with the existing API and route helpers.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Booking-recovery continuity depends on SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET, and later validators rely on it, so the shared environment/testing notes need to keep that prerequisite explicit.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: src/app/(public)/bookings/[bookingId]/page.tsx:49-64 mints continuation tokens only when SESSION_RECOVERY_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET is present; .factory/library/environment.md documents that prerequisite and .factory/library/user-testing.md notes /dev/booking-recovery shows a missing-secret message without it.

summary: Reviewed the feature handoff, commit diff, transcript skeleton, mission guidance, and related recovery routes/tests.
